questions.stem:
In a substitution language, each word has one distinct code. Code order is arbitrary.
banking savings rural = ni mi pa
banking digital growth = mi su ze
savings digital secure = pa to su
rural growth secure = ni ze to
banking savings secure = pa to mi
What is the code for “secure”?
questions.explanation: Answer: to. Compare the intersections of the coded lines. The complete consistent mapping is: banking = mi, savings = pa, rural = ni, digital = su, growth = ze, secure = to.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 40 km east, turns right and walks 72 km, then turns right and walks 10 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 78. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 30 km along the initial direction and 72 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(30² + 72²) = 78 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 80 km west, turns left and walks 105 km, then turns left and walks 24 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 119. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 56 km along the initial direction and 105 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(56² + 105²) = 119 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 80 km east, turns right and walks 76 km, then turns right and walks 23 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?

questions.stem: C is the mother of A. G is the daughter of A. E is the father of A. How is G related to E?
questions.explanation: Answer: Granddaughter. E is a parent of A, and G is A’s daughter. Hence G is E’s grandchild.

questions.stem: C is the brother of D. D is the mother of A. F is the father of C and D. How is C related to A?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal uncle. C is the brother of A’s mother D. Therefore C is the maternal uncle.

questions.stem: B is the only daughter of D. D is the father of B. H is the son of B. G is the sister of D. How is D related to H?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal grandfather. D is the father of B, and B is H’s mother. Thus D is the maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: In a queue of 35 candidates, a candidate is 13th from the front. After moving 3 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 20. New front rank = 13+3 = 16. Back rank = 35 − 16 + 1 = 20.

questions.stem: In a queue of 39 candidates, a candidate is 10th from the front. After moving 4 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?

65.02% of 579.82 + 900.12 − (21.98)² = ?
questions.explanation: Answer: 793. Round to 65% of 580 + 900 − 22² = 793. The choices are sufficiently separated for this rounding.

questions.stem:
I. x² − 12x + 35 = 0
II. y² − 18y + 77 = 0
Choose the strongest relationship that holds for all possible root pairings.
options: x = y or relationship cannot be determined
questions.explanation: Answer: x ≤ y. Factor I: roots 5, 7. Factor II: roots 7, 11. Compare all four pairings to obtain x ≤ y.

questions.stem: Two articles are sold for ₹2700 each. One earns 10% profit and the other incurs 25% loss. Find the combined cost price (₹, to two decimals).
questions.explanation: Answer: 6054.55. Recover each cost separately: 2700×100/110 + 2700×100/75. Equal selling prices do not imply equal costs.

questions.stem: Two inlet pipes can fill a tank in 30 and 45 hours. An outlet empties it in 90 hours. All three open together. Find the time (hours) to fill the empty tank. (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 22.5. Net rate = 1/30 + 1/45 − 1/90 = 2/45 tank/hour. Required time = 22.5 hours.

questions.stem: A boat covers 138 km in still water in 6 hours. If the stream flows at 2 km/h, how far (km) can it travel upstream in 3 hours?
questions.explanation: Answer: 63. Still-water speed = 23 km/h. Upstream speed = 23 − 2. Distance = speed × 3.

questions.stem: A and B invest in ratio 8:5. A invests for 12 months; B joins later and invests for 3 months. A receives ₹230400 profit. What is the total profit (₹)?
questions.explanation: Answer: 266400. Profit ratio is 96:15. Each ratio unit = ₹2400. Total = 111 × 2400.

questions.stem: A sum of ₹22000 earns ₹13200 simple interest in 3 years. At the same annual rate, what would be the amount (₹) after 2 years with annual compounding?
questions.explanation: Answer: 31680. Rate = interest ×100/(principal ×3) = 20%. Compound amount = 22000 × (1 + 20/100)².

questions.stem: A container holds 100 litres of pure milk. 20 litres are removed and replaced with water. This process is repeated once more, mixing thoroughly each time. How many litres of milk remain?
questions.explanation: Answer: 64. Each replacement retains 4/5 of the milk. Remaining milk = 100 × (4/5)².

questions.stem: The average weight of 29 people is 48 kg. One person joins and the average rises by 1 kg. Find the new person’s weight (kg).
questions.explanation: Answer: 78. New total minus old total = (29+1)×(48+1) − 29×48 = 78.

questions.stem: A is twice as old as B. After 19 years their ages will be in ratio 3:2. What is the present sum of their ages?
questions.explanation: Answer: 57. Let B = x, A = 2x. (2x+19)/(x+19) = 3/2 gives x = 19. Present sum = 3x.

questions.stem: A 210 m train moving at 86.4 km/h overtakes a runner moving in the same direction at 10.8 km/h. Find the time (seconds, to two decimals) to pass the runner.
questions.explanation: Answer: 10. Relative speed = (86.4 − 10.8) ×5/18 = 21 m/s. Time = 210/21.

questions.stem: The price of a commodity increases by 50%. A household keeps spending fixed at ₹2100. By what percentage must consumption decrease? (Round to two decimals.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 33.33. New quantity / old quantity = 100/150. Reduction percentage = 50/150 ×100.
